articles.title: Microsoft’s Xbox 25th anniversary console comes in translucent green
articles.summary: Microsoft has created a special edition Xbox Series X to celebrate 25 years of the console. The Xbox 25th-anniversary console takes design cues from the original Xbox console, with both the console and controller featuring a translucent green design. articles.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 gets a September release date
articles.summary: Minecraft Dungeons 2, a sequel to Microsoft's dungeon crawler spinoff Minecraft Dungeons, will be released on September 29th. The company originally revealed the game in a brief trailer in March, promising a fall 2026 release window. articles.title: Fable launches in late February after recent delay
articles.summary: Just a few days after pushing Fable out of 2026, Microsoft showed off more footage of Fable, the first new entry in the storied RPG franchise since 2010's Fable III, at its Xbox Games Showcase on Sunday. articles.title: Gears of War: E-Day isn’t coming to the PS5
articles.summary: Apparently, the "return of Xbox" means a retreat from other platforms.
